primary_direction: Measure and deterministically verify single-owner business transitions before adding more process or explanation.
limits: One generated application per arm does not establish a provider-wide effect.
Review findings and scores are advisory until a deterministic check reproduces them.
Readability and accidental-complexity scores saturated at 4/5 for every arm and do not distinguish this task.
Compact report artifacts preserve reviewer classifications, scores, and evidence locations; they are structured records, not verbatim transcripts.

replicated_finding_classes: operation identity lost on import and reconciliation errors
later reversal blocked by original closed date
mutation decision and returned result are not one atomic outcome
integer/storage exceptions escape the public model
commit failure bypasses rollback and stable error handling

conclusions: Spec Kit core was the only arm whose two reviewers both scored single-outcome ownership 4/5; its explicit transaction wrapper kept reads, writes, audit, and returned results together.
Proofmill standard did not preserve that advantage in this generation and did not improve readiness over the bare or instruction-only arms.
All arms were readable and low in accidental complexity, so more prose or fewer lines is not the present bottleneck.
The next benchmark investment should convert replicated review classes into deterministic concurrency, closure, reversal, storage-failure, numeric-boundary, and input-limit checks.
No replacement application is needed for direction: checkbook exposed material differences despite identical 15-scenario pass results.
